page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating hyperthreading resource sharing. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB RAM-to-core ratio.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The absence of integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing memory capacity and dedicated CPU execution over local storage speed or hardware-accelerated graphics processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated physical cores combined with a substantial memory footprint provides a balanced profile for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of hyperthreading. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
